        <script><![CDATA[var FinancialsCoreInvestmentBudget = Class.create();
FinancialsCoreInvestmentBudget.prototype = {

    getBudgetGridData: function(investmentId, sysId, timeScale, timeScope, entityStartDate, entityEndDate, table) {
        var budgetGridApi = new FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI();
        let budgetCostRecords = budgetGridApi.getCostPlanBreakdownBudgetData(investmentId, sysId, timeScale, timeScope, entityStartDate, entityEndDate, table, '');
        return {
            columns: this._updateBudgetCostPlanColumnConfigCurrencyOption(budgetCostRecords.costPlanCurrencyList, budgetCostRecords.columns),
            budgetData : budgetCostRecords.budgetData,
            costData: budgetCostRecords.costData,
            deleteCostPlanContextMenu: budgetCostRecords.deleteCostPlanContextMenu,
            fiscalPeriodHierarchy: budgetCostRecords.fiscalPeriodHierarchy,
            budgetAllocationAttributeData: budgetCostRecords.budgetAllocationAttributeData
        };
    },

    _updateBudgetCostPlanColumnConfigCurrencyOption: function(currencyList, columnConfig) {
        const costPlanBrkdwnDataApi = new CostPlanBreakdownDataApi();
        return costPlanBrkdwnDataApi.updateColumnConfigWithCurrencyOption(currencyList, columnConfig);
    },

    type: 'FinancialsCoreInvestmentBudget'
};]]></script>
